# ICrossChainRegistry
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/ICrossChainRegistry.sol)

**Title:**
ICrossChainRegistry

Generic interface for managing cross-chain relationships between different contract types

Provides centralized management of cross-chain relationships with support for multiple relationship types

### getTargetForSource

Get the target contract and chain for a given source contract and relationship type

This function returns the first registered relationship. Use getTargetsForSource for multiple relationships.


```solidity
function getTargetForSource(
    address sourceContract,
    bytes32 relationshipType
)
    external
    view
    returns (address targetContract, uint16 targetChainId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sourceContract`|`address`|The address of the source contract|
|`relationshipType`|`bytes32`|The type of relationship|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetContract`|`address`|The address of the target contract|
|`targetChainId`|`uint16`|The chain ID where the target contract is deployed|

## Events
### RegistryInitialized
Emitted when the registry is initialized


```solidity
event RegistryInitialized(uint16 currentChainId);
```

### RelationshipTypeAdded
Emitted when a new relationship type is added


```solidity
event RelationshipTypeAdded(bytes32 indexed relationshipType);
```

### BridgeRouterUpdated
Emitted when the bridge router address is updated


```solidity
event BridgeRouterUpdated(address indexed oldBridgeRouter, address indexed newBridgeRouter);
```

### DefaultGasLimitUpdated
Emitted when the default gas limit is updated


```solidity
event DefaultGasLimitUpdated(uint256 oldDefaultGasLimit, uint256 newDefaultGasLimit);
```

### CrossChainRelationshipRegistered
Emitted when a cross-chain relationship is registered


```solidity
event CrossChainRelationshipRegistered(
    address indexed sourceContract,
    address indexed targetContract,
    uint16 indexed sourceChainId,
    uint16 targetChainId,
    bytes32 relationshipType
);
```

### CrossChainRelationshipUnregistered
Emitted when a cross-chain relationship is unregistered


```solidity
event CrossChainRelationshipUnregistered(
    address indexed sourceContract,
    address indexed targetContract,
    uint16 indexed sourceChainId,
    uint16 targetChainId,
    bytes32 relationshipType
);
```

## Errors
### InvalidCurrentChainId
Thrown when the current chain ID is zero


```solidity
error InvalidCurrentChainId();
```

### BridgeConfigAlreadyInitialized
Thrown when bridge configuration is already initialized


```solidity
error BridgeConfigAlreadyInitialized();
```

### InvalidGasLimit
Thrown when an invalid gas limit is provided


```solidity
error InvalidGasLimit();
```

### AddressZero
Thrown when an address parameter is zero


```solidity
error AddressZero();
```

### RelationshipAlreadyExists
Thrown when trying to register a relationship that already exists


```solidity
error RelationshipAlreadyExists(address sourceContract, bytes32 relationshipType, uint16 targetChainId);
```

### RelationshipDoesNotExist
Thrown when trying to access a relationship that doesn't exist


```solidity
error RelationshipDoesNotExist(address sourceContract, bytes32 relationshipType, uint16 targetChainId);
```

### InvalidSourceContract
Thrown when an invalid source contract address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidSourceContract(address sourceContract);
```

### InvalidTargetContract
Thrown when an invalid target contract address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidTargetContract(address targetContract);
```

### InvalidChainId
Thrown when an invalid chain ID is provided


```solidity
error InvalidChainId(uint16 chainId);
```

### SameChainRelationship
Thrown when trying to register a same-chain relationship in a cross-chain registry


```solidity
error SameChainRelationship(uint16 chainId);
```

### InvalidChainRelationship
Thrown when neither source nor target chain matches the deployment chain


```solidity
error InvalidChainRelationship(uint16 sourceChainId, uint16 targetChainId, uint16 deploymentChainId);
```

### InvalidRelationshipType
Thrown when an invalid relationship type is provided


```solidity
error InvalidRelationshipType(bytes32 relationshipType);
```

### TargetContractAlreadyRegistered
Thrown when trying to register a target contract that's already registered to another source contract


```solidity
error TargetContractAlreadyRegistered(
    address targetContract,
    uint16 sourceChainId,
    uint16 targetChainId,
    bytes32 relationshipType,
    address existingSourceContract
);
```

## Structs
### CrossChainRelation
Represents a generic cross-chain relationship between two contracts


```solidity
struct CrossChainRelation {
    address sourceContract;
    address targetContract;
    uint16 sourceChainId;
    uint16 targetChainId;
    bytes32 relationshipType;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`sourceContract`|`address`|The address of the source contract|
|`targetContract`|`address`|The address of the target contract|
|`sourceChainId`|`uint16`|The chain ID where the source contract is deployed|
|`targetChainId`|`uint16`|The chain ID where the target contract is deployed|
|`relationshipType`|`bytes32`|The type of relationship (e.g., keccak256("ARK_FLEET_RELATIONSHIP"))|
